items.claim: The four findings that held up are fixed, one commit each with its own changeset. Three findings aren't defects, and one I only partly fixed: it needs a change in core that I left as a
addExtremeAnchors enabled by an 'xy' check whatever axis its params name
linkAnchor loses the drag when the link ops come back empty
fillet drag and `setFillets` clamp each corner against its neighbors' old cuts, not their new ones
items.note: (both paths now go through a new shared helper, `fillet/cornerRadii.ts`)

items.claim: girth replay reads the zoom in view now, not the one at the press
path-edit host with a mode `target` never tells subscribers when the open path moves to another node
fillet widget always draws a sharp corner as round, whatever shape the `editFillet` params give it
items.note: question (the widget can't see action params: `PathEditMarksCtx` doesn't carry them, and wiring the canvas registry's `paramsOf` into the path-edit overlay, and repainting it when a tuning changes, is a change to core outside this area. What I did, 0d9e632b12: the widget now reads `DEFAULT_FILLET_SHAPE` instead of a copied `'round'` literal. A tuned shape still doesn't reach the glyph.)

items.claim: `constrainAnchors` and `unconstrainAnchors` carry the `path-drag` tag though they are immediate commands
items.note: (`docs/path-operations.md` lists them under `path-drag` on purpose, as relations kept during anchor drags, like the handle-lock toggles, and `pathOperationTags.test.ts` enforces that listing)

items.claim: `constrainAnchors` stores any `length`, even negative, zero, or NaN, as a constraint that can never hold
items.note: (a negative or non-finite length now falls back to the measured one. Zero stays, since two anchors at the same point satisfy it. Falling back silently matches how the area's other numeric params are handled, so I made no `docs/unruled.md` entry.)

items.claim: addExtremeAnchors' `enabled` ignores `params.axes`, so it is on where its run adds nothing
Girth insert restores a stroke's misfit `vertexColors` that `withPath` just dropped
linkAnchor's reach goes negative under a flipped view axis, so no link is ever made
Girth and Knead add anchors to a linked node without renumbering the link nodes that tie it
setFillets with `radius: 0` on sharp corners is enabled and commits an undo step that changes nothing visible
Girth's width-point lines and its clear hit-test ignore the edge factor, so they miss the drawn edges of a nib or inner/outer stroke
Girth measures and writes widths in world units against a stroke whose widths are in the node's own units
linkAnchor loses the whole drag when a target is found but the link ops come back empty
Curvature comb options with a key present but `undefined` override the defaults and draw NaN teeth
linkTargetAt takes the topmost node's anchor within reach, not the nearest anchor as documented
linkAnchor's segment reach grows with an anisotropic view scale
